title: Multi-platform corroboration rerun after TikTok and Amazon public-data adapters
policy: No new z-score is invented for TikTok lifetime totals or a single Amazon BSR. Wikipedia uses the saved official series. Google Trends momentum is the 13 Nov 2026 live snapshot already published on the site. Missing platforms are listed, never imputed.

google_trends.method: pytrends TrendReq interest_over_time, today 5-y, US — 13 Nov 2026 snapshot

tiktok.method: in-page fetch of public /api/challenge/detail/ after StealthyFetcher session on tiktok.com
tiktok.notes: Lifetime cumulative counts (stock), not a 7-day flow. No z-score is computed from a single snapshot. TikTokApi hashtag.info() cross-checks the same challengeInfo on #crocs, #lululemon, #elfcosmetics.

tiktokapi_crosscheck.method: davidteather/TikTok-Api hashtag.info(), no login, playwright session

amazon_movers.method: Scrapling Fetcher of public Best Sellers pages; ranks from data-client-recs-list metadataMap.render.zg.rank; brand match on PRODUCT TITLE only (context matches discarded).

summary.interpretation: No ticker has two real z-scores above +0.5. The previous line that ELF momentum 57.97 'clears +0.5' mixed a 0–100 index with a z threshold. (57.97-50)/10 = 0.797 is withdrawn; it is not the formula that produced 57.97. Wikipedia z figures remain descriptive. They are not a fading claim, because last-day completeness was not stored. TikTok totals and Amazon ranks stay outside the z. Two TikTok clients on the same payload are a retrieval check, not independent demand.
